fact: Loi n°1/03 of 4 January 2011 establishes the national system of standardisation, metrology, quality assurance and testing and continues the Bureau Burundais de Normalisation (BBN), created by Décret-Loi 1/17 of 7 May 1992, as the sole body empowered to approve and publish national standards.
title: Loi n°1/03 du 04 janvier 2011 portant système national de normalisation, métrologie, assurance de la qualité et essais
